AUDIT-7 Lane 4 batch 3 progress — 91 valid PRs audited, 4 invalid payload references (2026-11-25)

This slice processed #7802, #7804, #7805, #7806 and #7809:

- #7802 → #2469: `audit:completed-later` via production Atlas embedding/retrieval PR #10832 and issue completion evidence.
- #7804 → #6055: `audit:complete` (counsel packet for five unresolved external-content questions).
- #7805 → #4716: `audit:complete` (file-route split and grandfather removal).
- #7806 → #2176: `audit:partial` (classifier leg delivered; other jewels remain on the open parent issue).
- #7809 → #6048: `audit:complete` (Presidio NER pass design).

The PR bodies, diffs, comments, source issue/comment captures, later-PR evidence, verdicts and label readbacks are in [the continuation ledger](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/audit7-batch3-five-20261125/doc/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7802-7809/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7802-7809.md), on the existing docs PR #14847.

Cumulative count: 91 valid PRs audited from 95 payload entries; four payload identifiers (#7667, #7668, #7693, #7694) are issues rather than PRs; 155 identifiers remain, next #7810. Earlier count corrections are recorded in comments 7156848591 and 7156775726.
